transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um… I guess I came in because I can’t get past this feeling that I’m a danger to people. Like, I had this near-miss, and I keep replaying it, and it just feels like proof that I shouldn’t be a nurse at all.

And I know people say everyone makes mistakes, but… I don’t know, it’s like my brain won’t let me believe that. I just feel like such a disappointment, like everyone would honestly be better off if I wasn’t there messing things up.
How long have you been feeling this way? Have these thoughts and feelings of being a danger to others and feeling like a disappointment been constant or come and go?

It’s been… a while. I think about a year and a couple months? Like, it really started after I graduated high school and then started taking college classes and working full-time at the clinic.

I remember thinking I’d feel more grown-up or proud, you know, like I was finally doing something real, but instead everything just started feeling heavier. And the thoughts aren’t always the exact same volume, I guess, but they’ve been there pretty much through that whole time.
Can you describe your mood most days over this time? Have you felt down or hopeless for most of the day, more days than not?

Yeah… most days, honestly. It’s like I wake up and there’s already this heavy, empty feeling in my chest before anything even happens.

I still go to the clinic and I can smile at patients, like if someone needs help in Spanish I can switch into that and seem normal, I guess. People probably wouldn’t even know. But inside I feel like I’m just barely holding myself together most of the day.
Have you noticed that you don’t take pleasure in things you used to enjoy, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you once looked forward to?

Yeah… I think so. I used to have little things that kind of helped me reset, like jogging after class or knitting, and I liked cooking when I had the energy to make something decent. I’d read too, like even if it was just a few chapters.

Now I’ll get home from the clinic and just sit on my bed in my scrubs for way too long. Like, I’ll think, “I should change, I should go for a run,” and then I just… don’t. I can’t make myself care about any of it, even though I know those things used to make me feel more like myself.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself or that you’d be better off dead?

I… yeah, I’ve had thoughts like that. Not like I have a plan to hurt myself, I don’t. It’s more like… sometimes I think it would be easier if I just didn’t wake up, or if I could disappear for a while so I wouldn’t mess anything up again.

And then I feel bad even saying that, because I know people have real problems and I’m supposed to be able to handle things, especially at work, but… yeah. Those thoughts come up.
Before this past year, have you ever had a period of time where you felt down or lost interest in things for at least a couple of weeks?

Um… before this past year? I’m not really sure. I mean, I’ve had bad stretches, like everybody does, especially with school and work and all that. There were times I felt really stressed or kind of shut down, but I don’t know if it was, like, for two full weeks or the same kind of thing.

It’s hard to separate it sometimes, because I’ll think about being exhausted after clinicals, or family stuff, and then I start thinking maybe that counted, but I don’t actually know. This past year feels different to me, more… constant, I guess.
Can you recall if there was a time before this past year when you felt down or lost interest in things for two weeks or more without it being tied to something like stress or a specific event?

I don’t think I can recall one clearly. Like… I had times where I was miserable or didn’t want to do anything, but usually there was something happening, like school pressure or work stuff or family stress.

It’s hard because I can overthink it and start connecting everything together, like, “Was that actually the same thing?” But before this year, I can’t point to a time that was just two weeks or more of feeling down or not interested without some reason attached. I’m not sure.
Can you think back and recall if there was ever a time before the past year when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks, even if you couldn’t figure out why at the time?

I… honestly, I still can’t think of a clear time like that. I keep trying to scan back, but then I get stuck on random stuff, like finals or working long shifts, or when I’d stop texting people because I was just tired, and then I’m like, “Was that it?” But I don’t know.

Before this past year, if I felt down or checked out, I usually had some reason in my head for it. I can’t really remember a separate two-week stretch where it just came out of nowhere.

Can you think of any time before the past year when you experienced a low mood or loss of interest for two weeks or more that wasn’t clearly tied to a specific stressor or event, even if you didn’t understand why you felt that way at the time?

I’m sorry, I know I keep circling around it, but I really can’t think of a clear time like that before this year.

Like, I can remember being really overwhelmed at different points, and then I start going off in my head about school or work schedules or family stuff, and it all kind of blurs together. But if you’re asking about a solid two weeks where I was low or not interested and it wasn’t connected to something specific… I don’t know. Nothing comes to mind that I can say for sure.

Can you think back to whether there was ever a time before the past year when you experienced a period of low mood or loss of interest that lasted for at least two weeks and wasn’t clearly tied to a specific stressor or event, even if you didn’t understand why you felt that way at the time?

I don’t think I can give you a better answer than… I’m not sure. I keep trying to remember it the “right” way, but then I start thinking about totally different things, like what semester I was in or where I was working at the time, and then I lose the thread.

Before this past year, I remember having rough stretches, but I can’t separate out whether any of them were just me feeling low for no clear reason versus something going on around me. So I don’t want to say yes if I’m basically guessing.
Can you recall if there was ever a time before you turned 18 when you felt down or lost interest in things for two weeks or more without a clear reason?

Before I turned 18… I don’t know, it’s hard to pin down. I keep thinking about school and being tired and, like, whether I was just being dramatic back then.

What I know more clearly is how it feels now. Most days I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling in my chest, and then I’ll go to the clinic and smile at patients, sometimes in Spanish, and try to sound normal. But inside I feel like I’m barely holding myself together.

So for before 18, I’m not really sure I can say yes. It’s more that this current feeling is what I can actually describe.

Can you think back and recall if there was ever a time before this current period—going back even before you turned 18—when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks, and it didn’t seem to be clearly connected to anything specific happening in your life at the time?

I’m trying to think back that far, and I just… I don’t really have a clear example.

I remember being sad sometimes, or kind of checked out, but then I start thinking, was that because of school, or friends, or just being exhausted, or something else? And then I get stuck trying to sort it all out. Even before 18, I can’t point to a two-week stretch and say, “Yes, that happened and there wasn’t a reason.”

So I guess my answer is still that I’m not sure. I don’t want to make it sound more definite than it is.

Can you think back to whether there was ever a time before this current period—going all the way back to childhood or adolescence—when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks and it felt like it came out of nowhere, not clearly connected to anything happening in your life?

I’m sorry, I know you’re asking it really clearly, I’m just having trouble pulling up something definite.

Like, childhood and high school kind of blur together when I try to think about feelings in that way. I can remember certain classrooms, or what my backpack looked like, or random stuff like sitting in the cafeteria, but then I can’t tell whether I was actually down for two weeks or if I’m just attaching that feeling to the memory now.

So… I don’t know. I can’t honestly point to a time before this and say it came out of nowhere. I might have had times like that, but I’m not sure enough to say yes.

Can you think back and recall if there was ever a time before you turned 18 when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks and it didn’t seem to be clearly connected to anything happening in your life at the time?

I know you’ve asked a few times, and I’m trying not to just ramble, but… I still don’t really know.

Before 18, I can remember little pieces of things, like being in school or coming home tired, but I can’t separate out whether I was down for two full weeks, or whether it was because of normal teenage stuff. And then I start thinking about unrelated things, like what classes I was taking or who I was friends with, and I lose the actual point of the question.

So, honestly, I can’t say yes. I don’t have a clear memory of that happening for at least two weeks with no obvious reason.
